biography.plain_text: Abdulkadir Konukoğlu is a Turkish industrialist and honorary chairman of SANKO Holding. Starting as an apprentice in his family’s textile business, he became general manager and succeeded his father as group chairman in 1994. He consolidated the companies under SANKO and expanded into cement, energy, education and healthcare before handing on executive leadership.

long_biography.plain_text:
Konukoğlu entered his family’s Gaziantep textile works as an apprentice in 1963 and learned production at successive levels. He progressed through operations management and deputy leadership before becoming general manager, building a long operating apprenticeship before succession.

After Sani Konukoğlu died in 1994, Abdulkadir and his brothers inherited the business, with Abdulkadir taking the group chair. He brought the companies together as SANKO Holding and oversaw expansion from textiles into cement, energy, packaging, healthcare and education. He eventually transferred the chairmanship and remains SANKO Holding’s honorary chairman. His public work also includes leadership of SANKO University’s board of trustees and long service to industrial organisations.

Konukoğlu entered his family’s Gaziantep textile works as an apprentice in 1963 and learned production at successive levels. He progressed through operations management and deputy leadership before becoming general manager, building a long operating apprenticeship before succession.

He brought the companies together as SANKO Holding and oversaw expansion from textiles into cement, energy, packaging, healthcare and education. He eventually transferred the chairmanship and remains SANKO Holding’s honorary chairman. His public work also includes leadership of SANKO University’s board of trustees and long service to industrial organisations.
